content:
anya: Heads up — noticed decision logs aren't showing header-based route overrides when sampling is enabled. repro on staging.

anya: Quick log snippet: `X-Route-Override: beta-3`
anya: but decision log shows matched_route: `stable-v2`

devon: that's bad. are we sampling before header normalization/override is applied?
max: probably. sampler key currently uses `request.path` at the very edge before rule evaluation.
max: if the override header changes routing, sampler will miss it and filter out the actual decision.

ops-sre: can you paste the full HTTP headers + trace id? I'll check the gateway trace.
anya: trace_id=674f9c2a, headers:
```
GET /api/v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.staging.redwood.ai
X-Route-Override: beta-3
X-Request-ID: 674f9c2a
User-Agent: curl/7.82.0
```

devon: looked at the route-eval trace: the rule engine applies override in phase 2, but the decision-log sampler runs in phase 1. bug.

max: short-term fix: sample using `request.evaluated_route_id` after rules run. long-term: move sampler to post-eval pipeline or record provisional keys and then finalize.

ziyi: ops-sre, wondering if we already have a toggle to force full decision logs for a given trace id so we can repro
ops-sre: yes: `./infra/ops enable-decision-logs --trace 674f9c2a --ttl 1h` (admin only)
ops-sre: enabled for that trace, you'll see verbatim rule-eval and final route in logs now :eyes:

routing-bot: Route override applied: service=chat-models env=staging override=beta-3 by header (trace=674f9c2a)

anya: confirmed — now decision-log shows matched_route=`beta-3` and full rule trace. I can reproduce sampling mismatch.

devon: created PR to change sampler key: `sampler.key = evaluated_route_id || request.path` and fall back; added unit tests.
max: also added integration test hitting header override + sampler on/off.

ops-sre: merged to staging. will monitor any noise in logs. follow-ups: console needs a visualization to show sampling decisions vs final route (so support can see why a trace was missing).

anya: filing a product/console ticket to add 'decision-sampling coverage' panel. keeping this thread for rollout notes.
anya: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
